# SCP Portfolio — Companies & Metrics

Marks as of the Q2 2026 valuation. "MOIC" is the gross multiple on invested capital at current
mark; IRR is gross.

| company | vertical | invested | current MOIC | gross IRR | EBITDA / scale | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Cedar Park Health](../projects/cedar-park-health.md) | Healthcare services | 2021 | **3.2x** | 41% | ~$28M EBITDA | performing; hold |
| [Ironwood Industrial](../projects/ironwood-industrial.md) | Industrials | 2018 | **2.8x** (expected at exit) | 22% | ~$35M EBITDA | **in exit process** |
| [Blue Harbor Software](../projects/blue-harbor-software.md) | B2B software | 2022 | **1.9x** | 28% | ~$60M ARR, 30% growth | performing; buy-and-build |
| [Meadowlark Dental](../projects/meadowlark-dental.md) | Healthcare services | 2020 | **2.4x** | 24% | ~$19M EBITDA, 42 locations | performing; add-on heavy |

## Notes
- **Cedar Park Health** is the fund's best performer — do not confuse it with the pipeline deal
  [Cedar Point Logistics](../projects/cedar-point-logistics.md), which SCP does **not** own.
- **Ironwood Industrial** is being sold; see the exit workstream and its founder-CEO
  [Michael Devlin](../people/michael-devlin.md).
- Platform vs add-on: Blue Harbor and Meadowlark are **platforms** pursuing bolt-on add-ons;
  Cedar Park is a single-site-turned-network operator.
- New-deal marks (not yet owned): [Halberd](../projects/halberd.md),
  [Onyx](../projects/onyx.md), [Cedar Point Logistics](../projects/cedar-point-logistics.md)
  are pipeline, not portfolio.
